input.plan:
# Symbol Palette and Outline Plan

## Goal
Enforce a single allowed palette for all combat symbols and update symbol shapes so readability improves (especially bloody hand/alcohol/red heart), while keeping current grid layout unchanged.

Allowed palette (derived from requested HSL):
- `HSL(0,0,0)` -> `RGB(0,0,0)` (black)
- `HSL(0,100,25)` -> `RGB(128,0,0)` (dark red)
- `HSL(0,100,50)` -> `RGB(255,0,0)` (red)
- `HSL(0,100,100)` -> `RGB(255,255,255)` (white)

## Files to update
- [AXEL/axel_project/combat/art/generate_placeholders.py](AXEL/axel_project/combat/art/generate_placeholders.py)
- [AXEL/axel_project/combat/art/placeholders](AXEL/axel_project/combat/art/placeholders)
- [AXEL/axel_project/combat/data/symbols/sym_green_circle.tres](AXEL/axel_project/combat/data/symbols/sym_green_circle.tres)
- [AXEL/axel_project/combat/data/symbols/sym_red_heart.tres](AXEL/axel_project/combat/data/symbols/sym_red_heart.tres)
- [AXEL/axel_project/combat/combat_test.tscn](AXEL/axel_project/combat/combat_test.tscn) (verification only, no layout edits planned)

## Implementation approach
1. Centralize the 4-color palette in the placeholder generator.
   - Replace ad-hoc RGB tuples with named constants for the 4 allowed colors.
   - Ensure every draw call in generator uses only those constants.

2. Switch geometric base symbols to outline-only rendering.
   - Update star, heart, triangle, and current circle symbol drawing logic to use stroked outlines only (no filled interiors).
   - Replace circle graphic with square outline graphic in the existing circle slot (to preserve current resource wiring and game logic compatibility).

3. Increase distinctness of bloody hand, alcohol, and red heart by silhouette + stroke rules.
   - Keep layout unchanged; improve per-icon readability using differentiated outline thickness, negative space, and contrast pairings from the allowed palette.
   - Avoid introducing any non-palette anti-aliased edge colors in generated outputs.

4. Regenerate placeholder PNG assets and keep symbol resources linked.
   - Re-run generator to overwrite files in placeholders folder.
   - Confirm `.tres` files still reference valid textures; only rename assets/resources if necessary.

5. Validate in combat test scene.
   - Confirm all symbols render with allowed colors only.
   - Confirm star/heart/triangle/square are outline-only.
   - Confirm bloody hand/alcohol/red heart are visually distinguishable at in-grid size.

## Verification checklist
- Pixel-level palette check on generated symbol PNGs: no colors outside `{black, dark red, red, white}`.
- Runtime check in combat grid: symbol recognition remains clear.
- No gameplay data changes (weights/tier behavior unchanged).

## Data flow
```mermaid
flowchart LR
symbolDefs[sym_*.tres resources] --> textures[placeholder PNG textures]
generator[generate_placeholders.py palette+shape rules] --> textures
textures --> uiSlots[symbol_slot TextureRect]
uiSlots --> combatGrid[combat_root GridUI]
```

Verify palette compliance and readability in combat test scene
